build_bmg_graph: build a probabilistic program graph using BMGraphBuilder with constants, distributions, and samples
generate_dot_representation: generate a DOT graph representation from a BMGraphBuilder graph for visualization
generate_bmg_graph_string: generate a BMG graph string representation showing nodes and their connections
generate_python_code: generate Python code from a BMGraphBuilder graph using the to_bmg_python generator
generate_cpp_code: generate C++ code from a BMGraphBuilder graph using the to_bmg_cpp generator
